snippet.title: BIG LOOT - Small Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116730/BIG_LOOT/

Roguelike adventure about caravans, trade and survival. Explore the world, choose your gear and route wisely - the road to the next town is full of surprises.

- Upgrade your wagon by crafting parts from gathered resources.
- Every journey is unique. Choose your route when leaving town: safe but modest, or dangerous but loot-rich.
- Pockets aren’t stretchy, but your backpack is. It literally expands from loot. Better drop it before a fight... but be careful, unless you want your goods to roll away.
- Loot and trade. Find valuable items, engage in trading, meet wandering traders, and improve relations with them to access rare goods.

#indiegames #indiedev #adventuregame #survivalgame #roguelike #loot
